perItemFindings.one_line: The finite-block sampling atom is encoded as an infinite `IIDSample` existence assertion; this contradicts the core’s finite-only sampling model, and `Causalean.Stat.iidSample_infinitePi` plus `iidSample_finN_pushforward` already supplies the needed proof-only extension.

perItemFindings.one_line: The notes claim no Causalean construction of an IID sample exists, but clean `Causalean.Stat.iidSample_infinitePi`, `iidSample_finN_pushforward`, and `event_pullback_along_iidSample` in `Stat/Sample/PiTransport.lean` directly cover the proposed infinite-ambient/finite-prefix transport.
